checks.conclusion: Full errors/messages survive checker details and durable checks. Feedback iterates every error or diagnostic with numbered excerpts, counts, omitted-character disclosure, message hashes and a full-record path/hash. Bound tests exercise 35/24 errors and 29 diagnostics.

Source/relation reset on each proposal; every proof context recomputes the current proof hash. Raw response records bind exact bytes. Final tests cover a malformed response after a valid source and an oversized replacement proof without stale source/proof hashes.
load_relation and preview slot validation are unchanged. Incorrect filename-like slots still fail INVALID_CANDIDATE; only guidance names the exact registered slots.

Transport adds six universal theorems in a new namespace, with no axiom, sorry, import or global simp attribute. Existing semantic definitions, generated-goal code, refinement inventory, adapters, transfer and acceptance policy are unchanged.

Catalog statements use arbitrary types/functions/guards/lists/naturals and no accepted symbol or reference body. Guidance retains exact generated inventory and pinned proof policy. Exhausted proof search stays unresolved; source-only admission is explicitly proof_checked=false.
